items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 15 October 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds and gales at first.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure over Iceland, driving a cold front across the area this morning.


##Wind##

Southwest 6 or 7, occasionally gale 8 at first, veering westerly 3 or 4 occasionally 5 later this morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate this afternoon.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, becoming mainly fair this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Westerly 4 or 5, veering north or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in places.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
